groups.title: Object-Oriented Python
groups.question: Explain how Python classes hook into the language's built-in behavior and how you decide between inheritance and composition.

followUps.Classes, Dunder Methods & the Data Model: What happens to your objects in a set or as dict keys if you define __eq__ but not __hash__?
followUps.Inheritance, MRO & Composition: How can a super() call skip an initializer under multiple inheritance, and when would you prefer composition?

groups.title: Type Hints & Static Analysis
groups.question: Explain what type hints give a Python team and how you model structured data with types.

followUps.Type Annotations & mypy: What kind of bug does running mypy in CI catch that tests often miss?
followUps.Dataclasses & NamedTuples: Why would you use a dataclass instead of a plain dict, and when is a NamedTuple a better fit?

groups.title: Advanced Language Features
groups.question: Explain how decorators and generators work and where you use them in backend code.

followUps.Decorators & Descriptors: Why does it matter that decorators run at import time rather than at call time?
followUps.Generators & Iterators: How does a generator keep memory low when you process a dataset larger than RAM?

groups.title: The GIL & Concurrency Models
groups.question: Explain how concurrency works in CPython and how you choose a model for a given workload.

followUps.The Global Interpreter Lock (GIL): Why does adding threads to CPU-bound Python code often give no speedup?
followUps.Threading vs Multiprocessing: What risk does threading bring with shared state, and what new failure does multiprocessing bring?
